name: lights-out
label: Lights Out
description: Lights Out puzzle on a LogiSheets grid — toggle a cell + its neighbors, turn every light off

scripts.build: vite build && craftsmith build . && yarn copy-to-public
scripts.copy-to-public: rm -rf ../../public/lights-out&& mkdir -p ../../public/lights-out&& cp index.html ../../public/lights-out/index.html && cp dist/lights-out.js ../../public/lights-out/lights-out.js && cp dist/manifest.json ../../public/lights-out/manifest.json && cp dist/tools.js ../../public/lights-out/tools.js

author: Jeremy He
